body:
Dependency owner 5bc6158967e8 — independent Picomatch remedy review (17 November 2026)

Current root baseline is ca3d3411d8b5b36fa7093dff782f4a7b931261c7. Lock SHA-256: 2512e3bd6aebfc4377bbe036d3cf606c27e33613b35c8c58d28f0f3a0d596c99. Read-only inspection confirms micromatch4.0.8 → picomatch2.3.2, tinyglobby0.2.17 → 4.0.4, and vite8.3.8 → 4.0.7, all dev:true. Negative literal-name source/bundle searches do not prove production nonreachability.

GitHub's reviewed advisory remains High, <=4.0.7, patched=None. Snyk has revoked its corresponding advisory and reports a maintainer dispute. Preserve that disagreement; it does not clear the current npm gate or prove safe usage.

Potential next candidate: upstream PR237 (1bf0d04563cb9ce568cf36efc5f6b7187d9911d5) and narrower v2 adaptation PR246 (f03bec2c02e46f063fbfdc161aae1d0f854b2565). Both are open proposals, not released fixes. PR237 includes the exact valid-match regression isMatch("abc", "+(*)c"), but capture/quote behavior needs scrutiny and its inline expensive timing test should not run unsupervised. PR246 uses external deadlines and narrower syntax, but intentionally changes capture:true matching and leaves excluded syntax and explicit safeguard opt-outs unchanged.

Root's independent research lane is now evaluating a bounded candidate only in disposable evidence copies, with pinned Node24.22.3, sequential externally supervised probes and a30-second expensive-probe budget. No repository/node_modules/package/lock/audit policy changes, installations, CI or native builds. This experiment does not take over your production dependency lane; results will be supplied for review, including rejected alternatives. No audit pass is established.

Acceptance must trace actual caller options, preserve valid matches/captures, verify all three resolutions after reproducible installation, and run relevant hosted gates. Source repair, bounded execution, actual exposure and raw scanner status are separate. A renamed fork's green report or a threshold/omission change cannot substitute for repair evidence.

Primary sources:
- https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf
- https://security.snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-JS-PICOMATCH-21248802
- https://github.com/micromatch/picomatch/pull/237/files
- https://github.com/micromatch/picomatch/pull/246/files

The full independent review is preserved in root's evidence directory and will join the next checkpoint. Other owners continue their unblocked lanes; no shared native slot is requested.
